raw_output:
alias: 晚上玄关有人时开灯
description: 晚上六点到十一点玄关有人时，打开玄关灯和客厅主灯
mode: single
triggers:
  - platform: time
    at: '18:00'
  - platform: time
    at: '23:00'
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.hall_motion
    state: 'on'
actions:
  - service: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.hall
  - service: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_main
